name: Regional Healthcare Network
modeling_notes: Milestone 1 figures reused where applicable: 2 hospitals, 14 clinics, 10 urgent care centers, 5800 endpoints, 1200 IoMT, 220 workloads, 42 vendors, $520M revenue, $505M expenses, $38M digital infrastructure spend.
New figures are invented for project demonstration and are not empirical healthcare benchmarks.
Existing $38M annual technology spending is separate from new $2M improvement budget.
Patient encounter categories can overlap; do not sum them to obtain unique patients.
Assets and controls are a simplified risk-model inventory, not a complete configuration management database.
